caption: The drawing depicts a single, closed book positioned at an angle, resting on a blank, light tan or beige background. The book cover is primarily red with a decorative central design that includes a yellow basket with green leaves and red fruit or flowers. The edges and corners of the red cover are outlined in a darker shade. The spine and fore-edges of the book are a yellowish, aged color, with some spots and subtle shading to indicate texture and wear. There is no text visible on the cover or spine. To the right of the book and below, the name "GRACE HALDINE" is inscribed in simple, fine lettering. The overall composition is centered, with the book as the sole object, and there are no additional elements or objects in the image.
title: Painted Tin Trinket Box
